sql: SELECT name FROM course WHERE name IN ('Intro to BlockChain','Computer Network') ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit < (SELECT credit FROM course WHERE name='Machine Learning Theory')
SELECT COUNT(prof_id) FROM prof WHERE popularity > (SELECT popularity FROM prof WHERE first_name='Zhihua' AND last_name='Zhou')
SELECT COUNT(T1.student_id) FROM RA T1 JOIN prof T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id WHERE T2.first_name='Sauveur' AND T2.last_name='Skyme'
SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id WHERE T2.capability=5

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.name='Machine Learning Theory' AND ((T1.f_name='Willie' AND T1.l_name='Rechert') OR (T1.f_name='Laughton' AND T1.l_name='Antonio')) ORDER BY T2.sat DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T3.f_name='Willie' AND T3.l_name='Rechert'
SELECT AVG(T3.gpa) FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T1.first_name='Ogdon' AND T1.last_name='Zywicki'
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type='RPG'
SELECT f_name, l_name FROM student WHERE gpa=(SELECT MAX(gpa) FROM student)
SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id=T3.student_id WHERE T3.f_name='Oliy' AND T3.l_name='Spratling'

SELECT T2.grade FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T1.f_name='Rik' AND T1.l_name='Unsworth' AND T3.name='Computer Network'
SELECT T1.phone_number FROM student T1 JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id=T2.student_id JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T2.grade='A' AND T3.name='Intro to BlockChain'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.grade='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.student_id) FROM registration T2 JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id=T3.course_id WHERE T3.name='Computer Network'

SELECT first_name, last_name FROM prof WHERE graduate_from IN ('Brown University','Columbia University','Cornell University','Dartmouth College','Harvard University','Princeton University','University of Pennsylvania','Yale University')
SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM student WHERE type='RPG'
SELECT T1.popularity FROM prof T1 JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id=T2.prof_id WHERE T2.capability=(SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) GROUP BY T1.prof_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.student_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT prof_id, student_id FROM RA WHERE capability=(SELECT MIN(capability) FROM RA)
